$comment: Contract of a hosting provider for tools/deploy/infra.mjs (docs/reviews/impl-notes/M2-06.md «Смена провайдера»). Timeweb Cloud: k3s on VMs (cluster profile k3s), managed PostgreSQL, S3, DNS. envs/<env> roots expose the outputs below and accept -var=ingress_ip.
name: timeweb
title: Timeweb Cloud
requiredEnv: API-токен Timeweb Cloud (без подтверждения удаления через Telegram)
закрытый SSH-ключ раннера (пара к settings.ssh_public_key): забрать kubeconfig k3s

outputs.env: registry_url, registry_push, domains {platform, systems}, network {pods_cidr, services_cidr, nodes_cidr}, postgres_cidr, s3_endpoint, buckets, ingress_ip
outputs.k3s_server: {private_ip, public_ip}: kubeconfig is fetched over SSH from private_ip
